extracted_concepts.name: Ratio
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A comparison of two quantities using division

extracted_concepts.name: Unit Rate
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rate in which the second quantity is 1, associated with a ratio

extracted_concepts.name: Proportional Relationship
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A relationship between two quantities where their ratio is constant

extracted_concepts.name: Rational Numbers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numbers that can be expressed as a ratio of two integers

extracted_concepts.name: Irrational Numbers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numbers that are not rational and cannot be expressed as a simple fraction

extracted_concepts.name: Number Line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A visual representation of numbers arranged in order on a line

extracted_concepts.name: Absolute Value
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The distance of a number from zero on the number line

extracted_concepts.name: Greatest Common Factor
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The largest positive integer that divides two or more numbers without remainder

extracted_concepts.name: Least Common Multiple
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The smallest positive integer that is a multiple of two or more numbers

extracted_concepts.name: Exponents
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A notation indicating repeated multiplication of a base number

extracted_concepts.name: Algebraic Expressions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mathematical phrases containing variables, numbers, and operations

extracted_concepts.name: Equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mathematical statements asserting equality between two expressions

extracted_concepts.name: Inequalities
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mathematical statements comparing expressions using greater than or less than

extracted_concepts.name: Area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The measure of the surface enclosed by a two-dimensional figure

extracted_concepts.name: Volume
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The measure of the three-dimensional space occupied by a solid figure

extracted_concepts.name: Coordinate Plane
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A two-dimensional plane defined by perpendicular x and y axes

extracted_concepts.name: Statistics
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The science of collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data

extracted_concepts.name: Probability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The measure of the likelihood of an event occurring

extracted_concepts.name: Mean
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The arithmetic average of a set of numbers

extracted_concepts.name: Median
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The middle value in an ordered data set

extracted_concepts.name: Interquartile Range
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The difference between the third and first quartiles of a data set

extracted_concepts.name: Mean Absolute Deviation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The average of the absolute deviations from the mean

extracted_concepts.name: Circle
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A closed curve where all points are equidistant from the center

extracted_concepts.name: Random Sampling
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Selecting a sample from a population where each member has equal chance of selection

extracted_concepts.name: Probability Models
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mathematical frameworks used to predict outcomes of chance processes

extracted_concepts.name: Integer Exponents
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Exponents that are whole numbers, including negative and zero

extracted_concepts.name: Radicals
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Expressions involving root symbols such as square root or cube root

extracted_concepts.name: Square Root
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number that when multiplied by itself gives the original number

extracted_concepts.name: Slope
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The rate of change of a line, measured as rise over run

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function whose graph is a straight line, typically y = mx + b

extracted_concepts.name: Pythagorean Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: In a right triangle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of squares of the other two sides

extracted_concepts.name: Rotations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A transformation that turns a figure around a fixed point

extracted_concepts.name: Reflections
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A transformation that flips a figure over a line

extracted_concepts.name: Translations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A transformation that slides a figure without rotating or resizing

extracted_concepts.name: Dilations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A transformation that enlarges or reduces a figure by a scale factor

extracted_concepts.name: Congruence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Two figures are congruent if one can be obtained from the other by rigid transformations

extracted_concepts.name: Scatter Plots
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A graph of paired data points used to identify patterns in bivariate data

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Model
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A straight-line equation used to approximate relationships in data

extracted_concepts.name: Constant of Proportionality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The constant ratio k in a proportional relationship y = kx

extracted_relations.evidence: Unit rate is derived from a ratio by dividing both quantities by the second quantity
Proportional relationships are defined by a constant ratio between two quantities
The unit rate serves as the constant of proportionality in a proportional relationship
The constant of proportionality is identified from tables, equations, and graphs of proportional relationships
Rational numbers are represented and ordered on a number line
Irrational numbers extend the number system beyond rational numbers
Absolute value is defined for rational numbers as distance from zero
GCF is used to simplify fractions within the rational number system
LCM is used to find common denominators for rational number operations
Integer exponents extend whole-number exponents to include negative and zero exponents
Radicals are expressed using fractional exponents, building on integer exponent properties
Square root is a specific type of radical expression
Equations are formed by setting algebraic expressions equal to each other
Inequalities are formed by comparing algebraic expressions with greater or less than
Linear functions are defined by equations of the form y = mx + b
The slope m is a key parameter in the linear function equation y = mx + b
The area of a circle is computed using the formula A = πr²
The Pythagorean theorem relates the areas of squares on the sides of a right triangle
Rotations are rigid transformations that preserve congruence
Reflections are rigid transformations that preserve congruence
Translations are rigid transformations that preserve congruence
Dilations change size and do not preserve congruence, unlike rigid transformations

Mean absolute deviation is a quantitative measure of variability in statistics

Linear models are constructed from scatter plots to solve problems
